label: bug
file: src/export/scheduler.ts

The issue with the weekly scheduled export not sending on the first week after creation appears to involve the calculation of the next run date in the weekly cadence. The function `nextRunAt` in `src/export/scheduler.ts` currently adds 7 days unconditionally for weekly schedules, which may not account for the actual schedule creation time versus the run time, causing the first scheduled export to be skipped. Investigating and adjusting the logic around the next run time calculation for weekly schedules would be a good next step to fix this bug.

input.title: Fix weekly scheduled export skipping the first week after creation
input.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Investigate and fix the issue where a weekly scheduled export created early in the day does not send the first export email on the day it is created. The problem appears to be related to the calculation of the next run date for weekly cadence, which currently sets the next run to 7 days after the last export regardless of the creation time. Adjust the scheduling logic to correctly handle the first week after a schedule is created so that the export is sent as expected on the first scheduled day.
